```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    barrier_col = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))

    target = hi + 1 if lo > barrier_col else lo - 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if 0 <= target < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][target] = 8
    return out
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the solid divider.
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                        if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    divider_row = next((r for r in range(h)
                        if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])), None)

    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    obj_color = next(v for v in counts if v not in (background, 2))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] == obj_color]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    if divider_col is not None:
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if c1 < divider_col:  # object left of divider; extend left
            edge = c0
            solid = all(grid[r][edge] == obj_color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))
            target = edge if solid and r1 > r0 else edge - 1
        else:  # object right of divider; extend right
            edge = c1
            solid = all(grid[r][edge] == obj_color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))
            target = edge if solid and r1 > r0 else edge + 1
        if 0 <= target < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][target] = 8

    elif divider_row is not None:
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 < divider_row:  # object above divider; extend upward
            edge = r0
            solid = all(grid[edge][c] == obj_color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1))
            target = edge if solid and c1 > c0 else edge - 1
        else:  # object below divider; extend downward
            edge = r1
            solid = all(grid[edge][c] == obj_color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1))
            target = edge if solid and c1 > c0 else edge + 1
        if 0 <= target < h:
            out[target] = [8] * w

    return out
```
